entries.name: Mossling
entries.summary: A walking knot of moss and root. Old trailkeepers say every grove begins with one curious Mossling.

entries.name: Ridgeback
entries.summary: Its warm stone plates store the afternoon sun. A charging herd sounds like distant summer thunder.

entries.name: Woolhorn
entries.summary: Cloud-soft wool hides a stubborn mountain heart. Their tracks are often the safest path through a blizzard.

entries.name: Glowmoth
entries.summary: A lantern with wings. Some ruins are only found by following their silent midnight spirals.
tags: mooncap fen, flowers and torchlit caves

entries.name: Shadecrawler
entries.summary: A many-legged absence between stones. Its eyes appear a moment before the rest of it decides to exist.

entries.name: Cave Blob
entries.summary: Mineral-rich water learned to hop. Cave Blobs remember every boot that has ever stepped in their pools.

entries.name: Rattlekin
entries.summary: Not bones, but stone remembering the shape of a traveler. The rhythm of its steps is older than the ruins.
tags: ruins, badlands and the night surface

entries.name: Zombie
entries.summary: A miner who stayed below one night too many. It remembers doors, footsteps, and almost nothing else.
tags: dark caves and the night surface

entries.name: Boglantern Mossling
entries.summary: Its hollow cap keeps one firefly-bright spore alive through every flood, relighting the hummock when the water falls.
tags: siltfen pools, mushroom fen hummocks and rainveil seep gardens

entries.name: Cindercone Mossling
entries.summary: A Cindercone can wait a decade for one storm, then cross an entire wash before the ground dries.
tags: painted badlands washes and the shaded feet of desert mesas

entries.name: Moonbloom Mossling
entries.summary: Wood-elves say each Moonbloom carries a map of the last clear sky it saw, written in pale veins across its petals.
tags: glimmerwood moonpetal rings and starfern clearings

entries.name: Moonbrawn Mossling
entries.summary: Moonberries feed a Mossling's patience; a Star Crystal gives that patience weight. The resulting Moonbrawn keeps the grove-tender's gentle nature inside a body grown for hauling stone and sheltering seedlings.
tags: waykeeper chrysalis looms and carefully tended moonberry gardens

entries.name: Sunstep Grazer
entries.summary: Its fan-shaped ears shade its face and flush copper when rain is coming.

entries.name: Pebbletortoise
entries.summary: Sleeping specimens are almost indistinguishable from the cairns they slowly rearrange.
tags: stony meadows, riverbanks and badland shelves

entries.name: Brambleboar
entries.summary: Seeds caught in its coat germinate as it travels, leaving crooked green trails through old forest.

entries.name: Petalfox
entries.summary: Its tail changes scent with the flowers it sleeps among.

entries.name: Emberbrush Fox
entries.summary: Its black tail forks frame a red center like banked coals. Caravans take a distant flash as a promise of firm ground.
tags: sunstep grass, painted badlands washes and desert scrub

entries.name: Moonpetal Fox
entries.summary: The pale eyes on its tails are not eyes, but they always seem to face the safest path home.
tags: glimmerwood moonwells and luminous fern terraces

entries.name: Duneclatter
entries.summary: Caravans follow its evening tracks to firm ground and avoid sinking dunes.
tags: desert dunes, cactus flats and temple outskirts

entries.name: Thimbledeer
entries.summary: Its tiny thimble-shaped antlers collect seeds. Every seasonal migration quietly redraws the edge of a meadow.

entries.name: Frostlace Hart
entries.summary: Every tine begins as frozen breath caught in winter velvet. The rack melts harmlessly when spring reaches the passes.
tags: frostpine openings, snowfields and high snowcap passes

entries.name: Reedcrown Deer
entries.summary: Mud and seed build a living crown around its antlers. A mature herd carries one wetland into the next.
tags: siltfen reed islands, rainveil floodplains and slow river margins

entries.name: Lanternshell
entries.summary: Fen paths once used sleeping Lanternshells as milestones. They moved slowly enough that the maps were usually right.
tags: siltfen roots and luminous mushroom hollows

entries.name: Puddlehopper
entries.summary: Each throat pouch carries a different hollow note. A whole pond sounds like rain falling into clay cups.
tags: river reeds, siltfen pools and rainy meadow hollows

entries.name: Reedstrider
entries.summary: Its hollow crest amplifies a call that carries over fog. River travelers use the answering echoes to judge a channel's width.
tags: siltfen shallows, broad rivers and meadow wetlands

entries.name: Wildwood Courser
entries.summary: Wildwood Coursers remember old roads long after roots and flowers have hidden them.
tags: open meadows, forest roads and upland glens

entries.name: Rimehoof Courser
entries.summary: Ice gathers on its mane without melting, then falls away in silver sheets when the herd begins to run.
tags: frostpine taiga, whispering snowfields and snowcap passes

entries.name: Sunscar Courser
entries.summary: The dark line beneath each eye is said to be the first road the sun ever burned into the desert.
tags: sunglass dunes and painted badlands washes

entries.name: Mirestride Courser
entries.summary: Reedcutters follow its paths because a Mirestride never commits its full weight to false ground.
tags: siltfen reed islands and flooded forest margins

entries.name: Starbough Courser
entries.summary: Each pale point along its flank appears only after the Courser has found a safe path home in darkness.

entries.name: Cloverback
entries.summary: Clover patterns bloom across its back in spring, making every herd look like a moving meadow.
tags: flower meadows and settled pasture clearings

entries.name: Sunbloom Longhorn
entries.summary: Sunflowers root in the dust caught between its shoulders. A herd in bloom can be seen moving across the plain from miles away.
tags: sunstep savanna waterholes and painted badlands grass washes

entries.name: Mistmane
entries.summary: Its wool traps morning mist. Trailkeepers once wrung drinking water from shed curls on dry climbs.
tags: cool cloudreed glens above wet valleys

entries.name: Sakurakit
entries.summary: Its tail keeps one blossom through every season. Nobody has seen it fall.
tags: pink forest glades, bloomwood edges and quiet orchards

entries.name: Sunwash Crab
entries.summary: Every shell carries a different sunburst. Coast children compare them like tiny heraldry.
tags: sunwash coast tide pools and bright sand shelves

entries.name: Taffy Hound
entries.summary: Every Taffy Hound is given a collar pressed with its borough's crest. The sweet is ceremonial; the loyalty is entirely real.
tags: sugarcourt kennels, hard-candy gates and bonbon borough lanes

entries.name: Praline Cat
entries.summary: Praline Cats always smell faintly toasted. Sugarboilers insist this proves they understand quality control.
tags: sugarcourt homes, sweet markets and warm sugarworks counters

entries.name: Rimecoat Hound
entries.summary: Its double coat sheds frost in silver flakes. Deepgear caravans trust a Rimecoat's nose when whiteout winds erase the road.
tags: frostpine trails, snowfield drifts and sheltered snowcap passes

entries.name: Bramblewhisk Cat
entries.summary: Seeds cling to the hooked whisker tufts without tangling. Grovekeepers read the little collections to learn where each cat wandered.
tags: wildwood bramble tunnels, bloomwood edges and rainveil understory

entries.name: Sprinklebug
entries.summary: One Sprinklebug is almost silent. A whole cluster sounds like a jar of decorations being carefully turned over.
tags: sugarplum vale gumdrop bushes, lollipop orchids and marshmallow shade

entries.name: Taffalo
entries.summary: Pulled taffy folds form its coat, but the warm marshmallow mane never seems to gather dust.
tags: open sugarplum vale clearings and peppermint terraces

entries.name: Emberjay
entries.summary: A flash of banked fire in the canopy. Its alarm call makes nearby grazers lift their heads.
tags: savanna acacias, badland cacti and warm forest edges

entries.name: Canopy Lark
entries.summary: Each flock improvises a local song, so patient explorers can hear when they have crossed into new woods.

entries.name: Tidewing Gull
entries.summary: A Tidewing's cry arrives before the coast itself, carrying over dunes and salt grass.
tags: sunwash coast cliffs, beaches and fishing water

entries.name: Frostquill
entries.summary: Its layered winter plumage scatters the blue of deep snow. Climbers follow fresh Frostquill tracks toward sheltered passes.
tags: frostpine boughs, snowfields and snowcap ledges

entries.name: Silver Shoalfin
entries.summary: Sailors read the direction of its silver flash to find currents near shore.
tags: open ocean shallows and kelp shelves

entries.name: Coralback
entries.summary: Tiny reef gardens travel on its back, seeding color wherever it rests.
tags: warm ocean reefs and deep coastal shelves

entries.name: Brookdart
entries.summary: Its blue stripe is brightest in clean water, making it a trailkeeper's favorite river gauge.

entries.name: Gloomfin
entries.summary: Miners once carried glass bowls of Gloomfins instead of lanterns. The fish objected.
tags: underground aquifers and flooded crystal caves

entries.name: Silverthread
entries.summary: From shore, a turning shoal looks like a silver stitch holding sea to sky.

entries.name: Reedneedle
entries.summary: Anglers used to mistake its shadow for waving grass until the grass swam upstream.
tags: deep river channels and reed beds

entries.name: Emberribbon
entries.summary: Its heat never boils water, but a handful can keep a traveler's fingers warm.
tags: warm reef shelves and volcanic springs

entries.name: Cave Filament
entries.summary: Cave Filaments make invisible aquifers readable, sketching every current in living light.
tags: underground water and flooded crystal seams

entries.name: Wild Honeybee
entries.summary: Each worker carries a map of flowers written in sunlight and scent.
tags: flower meadows, orchards and wild apiaries

entries.name: Hive Queen
entries.summary: A queen's wingbeat is lower than a worker's and can quiet an entire hive.

entries.name: Reed Dragonfly
entries.summary: Its four glass wings briefly show the color of whatever water lies below.
tags: river ribbons, fen pools and cloudreed glens

entries.name: Lightning Bug
entries.summary: Trailkeepers call their irregular lantern code summer lightning: a storm small enough to hold in one hand.
tags: humid meadows, siltfen pools and glimmerwood clearings

entries.name: Burrowbell
entries.summary: Its hollow tail tip makes a faint bell note when the whole colony races underground.
tags: sunny upland meadows and grassy town margins

entries.name: Dewback Tapir
entries.summary: Water beads on the pale saddle of its back, carrying seeds until the animal brushes through new ground.
tags: rain-dark forest pools and broad siltfen banks

entries.name: Redfin Salmon
entries.summary: Its red fins brighten on the long route home, sketching living arrows through a river.
tags: morning, rain and seasonal upstream runs

entries.name: Blue Mackerel
entries.summary: A turning school flashes blue like rain seen from below the sea.
tags: open ocean shelves and deep coastal water

entries.name: Slatefin Shark
entries.summary: Slatefins follow the cool seam below storms. Sailors fear them less than an ocean suddenly empty of them.

entries.name: Tideglass Crab
entries.summary: Its shell grows a thin tideglass window that catches moonlight even several fathoms below the surface.
tags: tidelight shelf seafloors, kelp beds and shallow reef ledges

entries.name: Reefglide Terrapin
entries.summary: Each shell garden grows from fragments collected along a decades-long circuit of the coast.
tags: tidelight shelf lagoons, seagrass beds and warm reef arches

entries.name: Glassfin
entries.summary: Its clear fins catch colors the surface never sees.
tags: deep ocean thermoclines and lumen trenches

entries.name: Lanternjaw
entries.summary: The pattern under its jaw is a name, warning and love song written in blue fire.
tags: lumen trench ledges and deep reef caves

entries.name: Abyss Skater
entries.summary: Abyss Skaters cross the dark floor without leaving a track, carrying gardens of tiny lights beneath them.
tags: deep sea floor, trench silt and whale-fall gardens

entries.name: Dreadcoil
entries.summary: Old sailors call a sudden ring of silent fish a Dreadcoil's crown.
tags: rare deep-ocean ravines and the edges of lumen trenches

entries.name: Tidepup
entries.summary: A Tidepup recognizes a familiar swimmer by heartbeat before face.
tags: kelp shelves, warm reefs and quiet atlantian outskirts

entries.name: Worldshell Leviathan
entries.summary: Whole gardens take root on old Worldshells. Cartographers have occasionally mapped one by mistake.
tags: rare open ocean routes, deep shelves and warm migration waters

entries.name: Aetherbell Larva
entries.summary: Every tiny bell contains the folded shape of a future sky-sailer.

entries.name: Aetherbell Leviathan
entries.summary: At night, a migrating Aetherbell makes the stars appear to swim.
tags: lumen trench migrations and the high cloud sea

entries.name: Syrupfin
entries.summary: A Syrupfin's glassy fins stay perfectly clean no matter how slowly the pond moves.
tags: natural syrup ponds in the sugarplum vale

entries.name: Meadow Cottontail
entries.summary: Its white tail is an alarm flag shared by the entire warren.
tags: flower meadows, orchard edges and open wildwood

entries.name: Russet Rabbit
entries.summary: Russet coats carry the same broken pattern as late-summer soil.
tags: savanna shade, birchlight scrub and upland fields

entries.name: Frost Hare
entries.summary: The dark tips of its winter ears are the only parts a snowstorm cannot erase.
tags: frostpine clearings, snowcap foothills and snowfields

entries.name: Cocoa Truffle Bunny
entries.summary: Sugarcourt children insist the tiny bow on its neck grows naturally.
tags: sugarplum vale cocoa gardens and syrup-dry knolls

entries.name: Sunset Sea Slug
entries.summary: Every individual carries a different horizon of rose, gold and violet along its back.
tags: warm ocean shelves and coral gardens

entries.name: Moonlace Sea Slug
entries.summary: Atlantian mosaics copy the branching pattern of its mantle, never the other way around.
tags: lumen trench floors and moonlit deep reefs

entries.name: Blue Dragon Sea Slug
entries.summary: Stormreaders call it a piece of sky that learned to swim under the sea.
tags: open-ocean surface currents and tide lines

entries.name: Leafsheep Sea Slug
entries.summary: Kelpkeepers swear a content Leafsheep makes nearby fronds lean closer.
tags: sunlit kelp nurseries and shallow reef grass

entries.name: Sea Bunny Nudibranch
entries.summary: Its resemblance to a rabbit has started arguments in every coastal academy.
tags: cool reef rubble and sponge gardens

entries.name: Spanish Dancer Sea Slug
entries.summary: Even Atlantian ballroom masters admit the Dancer invented the turn first.
tags: warm reef walls and sheltered ocean caverns

entries.name: Crystal-Tipped Nudibranch
entries.summary: The tips are soft tissue, though miners keep trying to appraise them.
tags: cold deep reefs and glass-coral gardens

entries.name: Sunring Phyllidia
entries.summary: Nothing sensible bites one twice; the rings make sure nothing needs to.
tags: tropical coral flats and tideglass shallows

entries.name: Hooded Melibe
entries.summary: A Melibe hunting in profile resembles a glass lantern trying to swallow the tide.
tags: kelp forests and silty deep-ocean gardens

entries.name: Sea Angel Slug
entries.summary: It has no halo; the cold blue organs shining through its body were enough for the name.
tags: cold open water above the lumen trench

entries.name: Embercrown Sea Slug
entries.summary: Its crown is cold to the touch, but few divers trust that fact on first meeting.
tags: volcanic springs and black-sand reef vents

entries.name: Kelpwarden Sea Slug
entries.summary: Kelpkeepers leave the oldest specimens undisturbed and call them gardeners, not livestock.
tags: ancient kelp roots and atlantian nursery terraces

entries.name: Starlight Choir Sea Slug
entries.summary: No sound is involved, but every observer agrees on where the chorus begins.
tags: lumen trench crystal choirs and abyss-bloom fields

entries.name: Voidglass Sea Slug
entries.summary: A captured Voidglass appears empty from one angle and full of stars from the next.
tags: the darkest lumen trench mineral seams

entries.name: Pocket Goldfish
entries.summary: It was named for size, not because anyone recommends carrying one loose in a pocket.
tags: quiet river pools, moonwells and planted aquariums

entries.name: Sunwheel Angelfish
entries.summary: At noon a shoal becomes a wheel of little suns, flashing one after another through the reef.
tags: sunlit coral gardens and warm tideglass reefs

entries.name: Stonewhisker Loach
entries.summary: Trailkeepers trust a Stonewhisker's clean whiskers as proof that a riverbed has not been poisoned.
tags: river cobbles and flooded cave floors

entries.name: Glimmerhart
entries.summary: Moonbough songs call each antler tine a promise the forest chose to remember.

entries.name: Runeowl
entries.summary: A Runeowl never tears a page. Tomekeepers consider that sufficient evidence of wisdom.

entries.name: Glowfin
entries.summary: Enclaves read their shifting rings as a gentle forecast of tomorrow's rain.

entries.name: Copper Mole
entries.summary: Its copper-colored guard hairs are keratin, though no Deepgear child accepts that explanation.
tags: snowcap range tunnels and deepgear holds

entries.name: Copper Scout Golem
entries.summary: Every scout's first step is witnessed by its golemsmith.
tags: while its aether key is charged

entries.name: Stone Bulwark Golem
entries.summary: Bulwarks have hollow chests so a hold's alarm bell can ring through them.
tags: while its aether key is charged

entries.name: Aetherforged Sentinel
entries.summary: A completed Sentinel is a public promise that the hold intends to endure.
tags: while its mana core remains attuned

entries.name: Deepgear Courser
entries.summary: Deepgear Coursers were built after ordinary packhorses objected, correctly, to freight lifts and powderworks bells.
tags: while its aether flywheel is charged

entries.name: Clockwork Hound Golem
entries.summary: The first hounds were made for delvers who missed their dogs underground; modern ones can hear a hostile footstep through two stone walls.
tags: deepgear gate kennels and golem forges

entries.name: Webspinner Golem
entries.summary: Eight independent leg governors let a Webspinner keep a tunnel covered even when the floor is mostly missing.
tags: deepgear defensive galleries and golem forges
while its pressure loom is wound

entries.name: Fire Dragon
entries.summary: Fire Dragons sleep beneath heaps of softened gold. Every twenty-five days of age leaves a darker ring along their horns and a wider shadow over the lair mouth.
tags: charred subterranean lairs beneath warm and temperate country
all hours near a guarded lair

entries.name: Ice Dragon
entries.summary: An Ice Dragon does not merely endure winter; the oldest carry a private winter with them, writing frost across every surface they pass.
tags: frozen subterranean lairs below frostpine and high snowy country
all hours near a guarded lair

entries.name: Steel Dragon
entries.summary: Steel Dragons are neither machines nor metal given life. Their scales simply learned the same lesson as a good blade: heat, pressure, patience, and an edge worth respecting.
tags: ore-rich subterranean foundry lairs below mountains and badlands
all hours near a guarded lair

entries.name: Sea Dragon
entries.summary: Its scales remember pressure. Older Sea Dragons carry dark bands for every depth they have mastered.
tags: rare abyssal nests in deep oceans and lumen trenches
all hours near a guarded nest

entries.name: Gold Dragon
entries.summary: Gold Dragons are not hoarders because they resemble treasure. Their living scales refine trace metals into radiant plates, and an elder's heartbeat can turn a dark cavern briefly into noon.
tags: vanishingly rare gilded cathedral-lairs beneath sunlit plateaus and old wildwood crowns
daylight and all hours within a guarded lair

entries.name: Silver Dragon
entries.summary: Silver Dragon scales remember every night sky reflected across them. Elders carry whole constellations in their flanks, rearranging the lights when they dream.
tags: vanishingly rare argent mirror-caverns below moon slate ridges and the deepest glimmerwood
moonlit nights and all hours within a guarded lair

entries.name: Hobbit Hearthwarden
entries.summary: A Hearthwarden carries the town ledger and the names of every family who helped raise its walls.
tags: day; appoints a successor at eight in the morning

entries.name: Hobbit Tiller
entries.summary: Tiller aprons collect seeds, flour, gossip, and at least one stone that looked useful at the time.

entries.name: Hobbit Delver
entries.summary: Delvers tap every beam twice: once for safety, and once so the mountain knows they asked politely.
tags: hobbit quarries, cellars and stone yards

entries.name: Hobbit Provisioner
entries.summary: Provisioners remember the fair price of a sack of onions from years before either trader was born.

entries.name: Hobbit Goldkeeper
entries.summary: Goldkeepers measure wealth in promises kept, though their ledgers remain extremely particular about the gold.

entries.name: Hobbit Hammerguard
entries.summary: A Hammerguard learns every loose stone in the wall and every child who uses the gate as a shortcut.
tags: hobbit gates, walls and patrol lanes

entries.name: Hobbit Boltwatch
entries.summary: Boltwatches carve one small leaf into a stock for every winter their town has stood unbreached.

entries.name: Goblin Roadboss
entries.summary: A Roadboss earns the iron key-ring by keeping paths open, fires fed, and rival bosses at a useful distance.

entries.name: Goblin Grower
entries.summary: Growers know which mushrooms cure a stew and which ones convince the stew to leave the pot.
tags: goblin fungus yards and terrace fields

entries.name: Goblin Sparkdelver
entries.summary: Sparkdelvers name promising rock seams and apologize when the seam turns out to be ordinary dirt.
tags: goblin mines, slag heaps and smith yards

entries.name: Goblin Bottlesage
entries.summary: Bottlesages label every mixture. Whether anyone else can read the labels is considered a separate craft.
tags: goblin markets and smoking bottle shops

entries.name: Goblin Spearwarden
entries.summary: Spearwardens keep bright ribbons below each spearhead so allies can read a patrol through dust and rain.
tags: goblin palisade gates and road patrols

entries.name: Atlantian Tidewarden
entries.summary: A Tidewarden wears one shell from every nursery their town has protected.
tags: atlantian council reefs and pearl halls

entries.name: Atlantian Kelpkeeper
entries.summary: Kelpkeepers measure seasons by the direction their longest gardens lean.
tags: atlantian kelp terraces and nursery gardens

entries.name: Atlantian Coralwright
entries.summary: A Coralwright builds slowly because the building is expected to keep growing after they leave.
tags: atlantian coral workshops and stone gardens

entries.name: Atlantian Pearlbroker
entries.summary: Pearlbrokers value a good story, then insist on paying separately for it.

entries.name: Atlantian Glowmender
entries.summary: Glowmenders say light is only medicine that has not chosen a patient yet.
tags: atlantian glow gardens and healing grottoes

entries.name: Atlantian Trident Guard
entries.summary: Their three points stand for home, current and the stranger safely guided between them.
tags: atlantian current gates and open village approaches

entries.name: Sugarcourt Crown Confectioner
entries.summary: A Crown Confectioner's first duty is to know when sweetness has become excess.
tags: sugar palace halls in sugarplum vale bonbon boroughs

entries.name: Sugarcourt Gumdrop Gardener
entries.summary: Gardeners claim every gumdrop has a preferred direction to face. Their harvest rows make the claim difficult to dismiss.
tags: gumdrop gardens and peppermint terraces in sugarplum vale bonbon boroughs

entries.name: Sugarcourt Sugarboiler
entries.summary: A Sugarboiler judges temperature by sound: bubble, sigh, then the single clear note before a batch catches.
tags: copper-kettled sugarworks in sugarplum vale bonbon boroughs

entries.name: Sugarcourt Candysmith
entries.summary: Candysmiths do not mind when visitors doubt their armor. They keep a hammer nearby for demonstrations.
tags: tempering halls and candysmith forges in sugarplum vale bonbon boroughs

entries.name: Sugarcourt Sweetbroker
entries.summary: A Sweetbroker can price anything except a recipe remembered from childhood.
tags: sweet markets and syrup-lit kiosks in sugarplum vale bonbon boroughs

entries.name: Sugarcourt Kennelkeeper
entries.summary: Kennelkeepers say a crest may be inherited, but companionship must never be.
tags: sugarplum vale taffy kennels, catteries and quiet borough courtyards

entries.name: Sugarcourt Brittle Guard
entries.summary: Their armor is tempered to flex once before it breaks, much like the oath beneath it.
tags: sugarplum vale hard-candy walls, gate arches and brittle barracks

entries.name: Wood Elf Elderweaver
entries.summary: An Elderweaver is chosen by consensus and by whether the oldest Moonbough accepts their touch.

entries.name: Wood Elf Leafwarden
entries.summary: Their leaves are never sharpened until the moment the spell is released.

entries.name: Wood Elf Bow-Warden
entries.summary: A bow-warden learns the sound of every gate before the range of a bow.

entries.name: Wood Elf Grovekeeper
entries.summary: Grovekeepers count successful nights, not harvests.

entries.name: Wood Elf Tomekeeper
entries.summary: Every returned tome is welcomed as though it had traveled alone.

entries.name: Wood Elf Potioner
entries.summary: Moonwell glass is washed in starlight before it touches water.

entries.name: Wood Elf Moonbroker
entries.summary: A fair price leaves enough wonder to invite a return journey.

entries.name: Deepgear Thane
entries.summary: A thane's chain carries one gear from every public machine completed during their term.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

entries.name: Deepgear Gatewarden
entries.summary: Gatewardens polish the entrance lantern before their armor.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

entries.name: Deepgear Delver
entries.summary: A delver carries chalk in three colors: safe, ask, and absolutely not.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

entries.name: Deepgear Gearwright
entries.summary: No gear is too small to receive a maker's stamp.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

entries.name: Deepgear Golemsmith
entries.summary: Golemsmiths speak to unfinished frames because silence makes careless work feel acceptable.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

entries.name: Deepgear Powderwright
entries.summary: Powderwright eyebrows are a subject one does not raise at dinner.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

entries.name: Deepgear Provisioner
entries.summary: Provisioners estimate a tunnel crew's tea consumption from the sound of their boots.
tags: underground deepgear holds beneath the snowcap range

tags: rootweave grotto clearings and pillarstone lichen shelves
all hours in dim ecological centers

entries.name: Lanternray
entries.summary: A school seen from a high ledge resembles a second night sky moving under glass.
tags: starbloom hollows light gardens and broad glasswater deeps ceilings

entries.name: Prismtail Swift
entries.summary: Miners learned to stop swinging when a Prismtail flock falls silent; the birds hear stressed stone before it breaks.
tags: crystaldeep gallery vaults with long uninterrupted flight lanes

entries.name: Glassback Newt
entries.summary: Its clear back is not fragile glass but layered mineral cartilage grown from the water it inhabits.
tags: shallow glasswater shelves, egg-reed beds and dripping limestone margins

entries.name: Sailfin Skimmer
entries.summary: Its fin records the chemistry of every pool crossed as a band of color, giving old skimmers the look of living maps.
tags: glasswater rivers, flooded stone roads and mineral-dam spillways

entries.name: Ashnose Bat
entries.summary: Ashnose colonies redraw their route every night as fumaroles open and close. Their guano is prized because it remembers those minerals.
tags: dark ordinary tunnels bordering pillarstone and emberdeep

entries.name: Chimewing
entries.summary: Lost delvers sometimes follow a Chimewing cadence to an ecological center. Sometimes the cadence follows them first.
tags: starbloom hollows and the quiet margins of crystaldeep gallery

entries.name: Cinder Kite
entries.summary: Cinder Kites nest where stone is still deciding whether to melt. Dwarven ventwrights read their circling height as a pressure gauge.
tags: emberdeep fumarole thermals above lava pockets and abandoned vent forges

entries.name: Embercarapace Beetle
entries.summary: Its black wing-cases insulate a living furnace. Dwarven ventwrights call a retreat when a whole colony turns its glowing abdomens toward the same wall.
tags: emberdeep fumarole basalt shelves and the dark tunnels immediately beyond their glow
fumarole surges and the cooling hours after them

entries.name: Veinling
entries.summary: No agreement exists on whether a Veinling is born, built, grown or merely noticed. Its behavior supports every theory and proves none.
tags: rare living veins crossing crystaldeep and forgotten stone roads

entries.name: Auric Scarab
entries.summary: Each scarab plates itself with the first precious metal it finds. Old prospectors listen for the soft click of a whole fortune walking away.
tags: buried caravans, brass ruins and starfall rubble

entries.name: Rootwrithe
entries.summary: The first labyrinth gardeners did not build doors. They taught the hedges to remember who belonged inside.
tags: ancient gardens and the rootbound labyrinth

entries.name: Bellroot Matron
entries.summary: A Matron grows around every promise a grove refuses to forget. Its bell is a seedpod, a warning and a funeral hymn at once.
tags: sacred amphitheaters and bloomrot altar gardens

entries.name: Vaultwing
entries.summary: Its translucent ears map rooms by starlight. A whole roost can memorize a corridor without ever touching its walls.
tags: observatory domes, lighthouse crowns and sealed galleries

entries.name: Cinder Maw
entries.summary: Foundry keepers once used their heat to restart cold furnaces. The furnaces are cold now; the hounds are not.
tags: emberwatch ruins, foundry vents and storm gates

entries.name: Ossuary Keeper
entries.summary: No one remembers the keepers' makers. Every one still carries a key, and every key fits a door that no longer exists.
tags: master-vaults, colossus ruins and observatory crowns

entries.name: Mossback Kite
entries.summary: Roost keepers say a Mossback Kite grows one new patch of moss for every road it learns from the air.
tags: whistlekite roosts above meadows, savannas and highland passes

entries.name: Clockwork Marmot
entries.summary: No Dwarf admits to inventing them. Every Dwarf admits they keep better time than the depot clocks.
tags: warm machinery hollows and collapsed survey engines in cold highlands

entries.name: Inkmaw Curator
entries.summary: It was instructed to preserve every true version of the archive. When two histories disagreed, it learned to erase the reader.
tags: the last folio at the bottom of a palimpsest vault
whenever an archive seal is broken

entries.name: Peelop
entries.summary: Its ears ripen from green to gold. A content Peelop smells faintly of warm bread and bananas.
tags: sunny orchard hollows and peelop picnic groves

entries.name: Reliquary Sentinel
entries.summary: Two vanished orders carved the same guardian in different stone. Neither admitted learning from the other.

entries.name: Skeleton Archer
entries.summary: A patient hunter held together by old cord and an even older grudge.
tags: ruins, caves and the night surface

entries.name: Road Warg
entries.summary: A Warg remembers every road it has guarded and every rider who treated it as a partner rather than a tool.
tags: goblin roads, scrubland forts and rare feral upland packs

entries.name: Thornhide Trufflehog
entries.summary: Old orchard keepers say a Trufflehog does not find mushrooms; it listens until the forest admits where it hid them.
tags: mushroom fen and rain-soft bloomwood clearings

entries.name: Orchard Glider
entries.summary: A glider nest is assembled from one seed of every tree it has crossed, a tiny map of an orchard not yet grown.
tags: birchlight, bloomwood, and sakurabloom canopy edges

entries.name: Petalmask Tanuki
entries.summary: The oldest masks are repaired with sap instead of replaced; each crack marks a trick that failed and a lesson the animal kept.
tags: rainy sakurabloom groves and glimmerwood paths

entries.name: Ironbeak Magpie
entries.summary: Deepgear miners treat a Magpie returning a lost fastener as luck; one stealing the same fastener twice is considered an inspection.
tags: forest roads, wayposts, and abandoned settlement roofs

entries.name: Hearthback Badger
entries.summary: Travelers once followed the smoke-colored stripe on its back home, mistaking it for a road warmed by a distant hearth.
tags: wildwood banks and frostpine root burrows

entries.name: Sunfoil Pangolin
entries.summary: No two scale rows catch the sun in the same order, so caravans once named individuals as moving hours of the day.
tags: sunstep savanna termite fields and painted badlands ledges

entries.name: Glassstep Jerboa
entries.summary: Desert children read its moonlit hop pattern as a warning alphabet for hollow ground.
tags: sunglass desert dunes and moonlit glass flats

entries.name: Stormcrest Ibex
entries.summary: A resting herd always leaves one horn pointed into the wind; climbers who notice it in time rarely walk into the storm's worst face.

entries.name: Cindercoil Gecko
entries.summary: Kilnkeepers trust a sleeping Gecko more than a dial: it leaves before the first brick cracks.
tags: ember wastes basalt and hot painted badlands ledges

entries.name: Cloudkite Pika
entries.summary: Their hay piles are weighted with exactly one stone from above and one from below, a small treaty between cliff and cloud.
tags: cloudreed peaks and sheltered highland scree

entries.name: Briarclaw Lynx
entries.summary: The white old hunter of Frostpine is not feared for being unseen, but for allowing itself to be seen exactly once.
tags: rare wildwood, frostpine, and bloomwood cover

entries.name: Gravebell Jackal
entries.summary: Returning a relic earns silence; stealing one earns a bell note that follows a thief much farther than paws do.
tags: painted badlands ruins and ember wastes cairns

entries.name: Cragglass Basilisk
entries.summary: Its victims are not statues but patient animals caught in a mineral trance, often waking days later beneath a new skin of dust.
tags: badland stone circles and crystaldeep fringes

entries.name: Stormglass Roclet
entries.summary: At level thirty the name Roclet is no longer accurate, but highlanders keep it as a reminder that every great Roc was once carried home in a blanket.

entries.name: Brinewhisk Otter
entries.summary: A lost boat key has a better chance of returning in an Otter's paws than in a fisher's net—provided the finder is thanked with the right shell.
tags: wandering river, siltfen pools, and sunwash coast

entries.name: Riverwright Beaver
entries.summary: The spiral notches on an old dam are not decoration; they are a maintenance ledger readable to every colony downstream.
tags: rare wandering river colonies and siltfen channels

entries.name: Mirecrown Crane
entries.summary: Where a Mirecrown completes its dance, pond keepers expect clean water and new flowers before the next moon.
tags: migratory siltfen and flower meadow ponds

entries.name: Inkveil Cuttle
entries.summary: The observatory cuttle does not copy objects. It copies the last emotion of anyone reflected in its glass.
tags: brightwater reefs, abyssal shelves, and lumen trench observatories

entries.name: Prismclaw Mantis Shrimp
entries.summary: Tideglass masons test windows by letting a Prismclaw look at them. If the animal loses interest, the glass will outlive the wall.
tags: reef caverns and lumen trench structure seams

entries.name: Reefmender Shrimp
entries.summary: A reef without a mender may still be colorful. A reef with one is quiet enough for every color to stay.

entries.name: Currentweaver Eel
entries.summary: A Currentweaver is never struck by the same current twice; it edits the second one before it arrives.
tags: lumen trench, abyssal ocean, and glasswater currents
storms, charged lures, and strong currents

entries.name: Shellcarrier Hermit
entries.summary: The finest shell is not the brightest but the one the Hermit leaves behind without looking back.

entries.name: Wreckwhistle Porpoise
entries.summary: Sailors follow the descending whistle to wreckage and the rising whistle home. Confusing the two is considered an insult to the listener.
tags: rare ocean pods along old wreck routes

entries.name: Kilnscale Salamander
entries.summary: Delvers once carried them as living coals until they learned the animal prefers choosing its own hearth.
tags: emberdeep fumaroles and heated mineral terraces

entries.name: Sporeback Gardener
entries.summary: Its garden is inheritance, shelter, and biography. A bare-backed Gardener is not young but newly arrived.
tags: rootweave grotto and old fungal pockets

entries.name: Voidmantle Ray
entries.summary: It does not fly so much as refuse to decide whether the cavern is air or sea.
tags: very large glasswater and pillarstone caverns

entries.name: Fossilback Trilobite
entries.summary: Its shell resembles a fossil because fossils resemble its ancestors; the animal has never had reason to hurry away from a successful design.
tags: glasswater beds and pillarstone sediment shelves

entries.name: Ilyr Virebloom, the Walking Spring
entries.summary: Ilyr is not the source of the watershed. It is the promise that separated waters can remember one another.
tags: a restored migration between three dry ecological centers

entries.name: Thalassene, the Reef That Swims
entries.summary: Maps draw reefs as places. Thalassene is the old correction: some places choose where to be.
tags: a migrating reef route between brightwater and collapsing trenches

entries.name: Orichalc, the Oath Under Stone
entries.summary: The Delvers call it an oath because every witness describes a different heart and agrees that something answered.
tags: a protected veinmetal seam below a deepgear hold
when the living seam is interpreted rather than mined

entries.name: Varkesh Stormmane
entries.summary: Varkesh does not guard the road. It guards the idea that a road must still lead somewhere after the storm.
tags: the storm aerie above rebuilt highland wayposts

entries.name: Kharza, the Red Banner Warg
entries.summary: The banner is not allegiance. It is every order Kharza survived long enough to tear in half.
tags: a rival-company coercion camp beyond the brassroot roads

entries.name: The Sugarwake Sovereign
entries.summary: No confectioner made the Sovereign. Each made the part they were certain mattered most, and the feast supplied the argument between them.
tags: when competing festival works awaken together

entries.name: Bellstep Qilin
entries.summary: The road did not tame the Qilin. It learned courtesy by watching which travelers repaired what they did not break.
tags: the road of quiet bells across desert, badlands, and old savanna routes
at dawn after every roadside bell is tuned

entries.name: Aerolith Baleen
entries.summary: Its baleen combs weather rather than krill, straining old voices from the wind and returning them to the graveyard.
tags: cloudwhale graveyards above cloudreed glen and exposed highland cliffs

entries.name: Mireglass Kelpie
entries.summary: Every fen keeps one path for the lost and another for those who enjoy making others lost.
tags: the mirrorfen processional in swamps, fens, and flooded jungle roads

entries.name: Cinderwing Pyrausta
entries.summary: Pyraustae are born from flame only in tavern stories. In truth they work very hard to keep their eggs from becoming flame.
tags: the emberglass hatchery in ember wastes and emberdeep vents
stable heat and protected hatchery cycles

entries.name: Nacre Gatewyrm
entries.summary: The gate is not a door. It is the agreement that water may enter only after asking.
tags: the drowned moon gate beneath lumen trench and abyssal shelf

entries.name: Frostcauldron Behemoth
entries.summary: Dwarves measure mountain weather by the Kettle's sleep. A waking snort means the pass has made a decision.
tags: titan's kettle in snowcap range, snowfield, and frostpine country

entries.name: Briarcrown Manticore
entries.summary: Its old keepers called the crown a restraint. The manticore remembers it as a garden that happened to have rules.
tags: the root-crown menagerie above rootweave under glimmerwood and wildwood

entries.name: Ammonarch
entries.summary: The orchard grows histories slowly enough that stone mistakes them for minerals.
tags: the fossil orchard in pillarstone halls and crystaldeep

entries.name: Handtail Ahuizotl
entries.summary: Stories blame the hand for drownings because stories rarely ask what the hand was trying to retrieve.
tags: the lanternroot cistern between rootweave grotto and glasswater

entries.name: Tideclock Cetus
entries.summary: Its clock never tells the hour. It measures how long a lost thing has been willing to be found.
tags: the tideclock wreck across brightwater shelf and the abyssal shelf
long currents and turning wreck bells

entries.name: Anemoi Gryphon
entries.summary: Each wind claims to be the first. The gryphon has heard all nine arguments and is impressed by none.
tags: the palace of nine winds above cloudreed glen and the highlands
when all nine palace drafts are open

entries.name: Sable Gorgon
entries.summary: Petrification is the quarry's word for preservation. The Gorgon has never agreed that stillness and death are the same.
tags: the gorgon quarry descending from badlands and desert into crystaldeep

entries.name: Namarra Makara
entries.summary: Namarra sank by choice when its rulers mistook height for dignity. The Makara has kept the better parts of court below.
tags: the sunken court of namarra in lumen trench and deep ocean
pearl audiences and restored air gardens

entries.name: Ashen Salamander King
entries.summary: Every king burned the previous king's account. The library survived by learning to write in temperature.
tags: the ashen library of salamander kings in ember wastes and emberdeep

entries.name: Mycelial Oneirophant
entries.summary: It does not dream of places it has visited. Places become capable of dreaming after it remembers them.
tags: the hollow moon menagerie between mooncap hollow and starbloom gallery
dormant dream cycles and restored memory ponds

entries.name: Asterjaw
entries.summary: It follows roads that were planned, dreamed, or abandoned, where distance obeys intention before geometry.
tags: for 75 seconds, or permanently after a valid worldpin grounding

entries.name: Vellum Warden
entries.summary: Every erased sentence becomes terrain in its home realm, and every repeated action leaves a margin note.
tags: for 90 seconds, or permanently after a valid worldpin grounding

entries.name: Choir-of-One
entries.summary: Its realm is the interval after a bell moves but before sound is allowed to exist, where declarations arrive before actions.
